inputs.name: registerActivityCommand.program
inputs.description: The commander Command that receives the new 'activity' subcommand; it matters on every call because registerActivityCommand immediately runs program.command('activity') on it. The function does not validate the value, so it must already be a commander Command.

outputs.name: registerActivityCommand
outputs.description: The 'activity' Command that registerActivityCommand adds to program and returns, so that callers can reach the show, register, heartbeat <id>, finish <id> and agents subcommands attached to it. Their action handlers run only when commander dispatches to them, not during this call.
